Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source activities, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno and molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613918' via activities.assay_id, standard_value is not null, standard_relation = '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
